consumer: The frontend map renderer reading snapshot tiles[].ter/.furn, asking 'what terrain/furniture symbol do I paint at each nearby tile?'
scope: a map region: the nearby tiles within the export window/radius around the center
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (per tile) writes ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() and ctx.m.furn(p).id().str() per nearby tile into the snapshot JSON the map view displays
divergence: A tile whose terrain was changed in-engine (e.g. a wall smashed t_wall->t_floor, or furniture removed f_table->f_null) but the map view still renders the stale prior symbol, so the displayed terrain/furniture diverges from what the GUI should show.
